summary: Ferrovial N.V., a Dutch infrastructure company, filed a Form 6-K announcing the voluntary delisting of its ordinary shares from Euronext Amsterdam, effective September 11, 2026, with the last trading day on September 10, 2026. The delisting follows a strategic review of its listing structure after liquidity concentrated on Nasdaq (59.21% of average daily trading volume) and Spanish exchanges (40.63%), leaving Amsterdam at only 0.15%. Euronext Amsterdam approved the request. Ferrovial remains listed on Nasdaq and Spanish exchanges. The company will continue to follow Dutch corporate governance rules. What to watch: no impact on US listing; monitor any residual Dutch regulatory or tax implications.
